artworks.title: Two Young Women
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image features two figures depicted from head to toe. The figure on the left is standing with one arm extended holding the lid of a large urn or vase on a pedestal. The figure on the right stands slightly behind and to the side, appearing engaged in conversation or observation. Both figures have facial features and hair with classical styling. They are dressed in flowing, classical attire. No visible jewelry is present. The background consists of closely spaced diagonal lines on brown paper with a simple border.

artworks.title: Provincial Figures
artworks.medium: graphite on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of various figures depicted in simple pencil outlines. The bodies are shown from head to toe, some standing and some seated. The facial features are minimally detailed and some figures wear hats. The clothing ranges from dresses to looser garments. One figure balances an object on their head and another appears to be carrying something. The sketch does not have a detailed background and features the signature 'G. Boudin' at the bottom left.

artworks.title: The Coast at Concarneau
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation

artworks.title: Women at a Well, Allinges
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The sketch shows a scene with characters, a building, trees, and a distant landscape. The point of view is slightly elevated. The horizon is high in the composition, with hills or a distant landscape visible through trees. The sketch is detailed with varied pencil strokes for contrast and depth. The brushwork is loose and sketchy. The color palette is monochromatic. Two figures stand near a well-like structure, with a building partly visible on the right. Trees fill the background, with light lines indicating distant hills.

artworks.title: Passengers on Shipboard
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image features sketches of people in various positions and angles, focusing on the upper torso. The sketches show individuals with softly detailed facial features, varying hairstyles, and clothing typical of an earlier era. Some are sitting or standing, while others are shown from front, profile, or three-quarter views. There are no visible accessories or objects, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Herds Crossing a Stream
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays a pencil sketch showing people interacting with animals in a rural setting. The composition features a high horizon with an open sky. Trees frame the scene on either side. The brushstrokes are loose and gestural, creating a sense of movement. The monochromatic color palette consists of shades of gray. The sketch depicts individuals with cattle and sheep, as well as figures managing carts in the distance, portraying a lively scene of pastoral life.

artworks.title: Peasants and Cows [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of various sketches on a page. There are roughly sketched outlines of figures engaged in different actions throughout the page. The drawing includes seated and standing positions, with flowing lines suggesting movement of clothing. In the lower section, a cow is depicted standing next to one of the figures. The drawing is done with light pencil work, creating a spontaneous and quick sketching style, capturing fleeting moments or ideas. The overall composition is loose and sketch-like, rather than a finished piece.

artworks.title: Herdsmen and Cattle
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The pencil sketch depicts a scene with a horizon in the distance, trees, figures, and livestock below. A tree to the left provides shade to the gathered individuals. The drawing uses loose strokes and bold lines to outline elements, and a monochromatic palette conveys texture and form.

artworks.title: The Legend of the Wolves
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping and erasing, black chalk, and pastel on blue wove paper, edge mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This drawing shows a rocky, dark-blue landscape under an overcast night sky. In the center, a person on horseback stands on a tall rock. The person appears human, but they have tall, pointed ears on the top of their head, and their eyes are small points of bright orange. No other details are distinguishable. The horse they sit on stands tall, facing the right. Its mane and tail are blowing in the wind, and small streaks of orange light are coming out of its nostrils, as if it is breathing fire. Surrounding this large boulder, across the rest of the rocky landscape, a pack of dogs runs from the left side of the drawing towards the lower right corner, jumping off a grassy hill. They have upright, pointed ears and thin tails. Many of them have glowing orange eyes and thin lines of orange emerging from their open maws. The sky above is covered with thin gray clouds, and the light from a partially obscured moon illuminates the scene.

artworks.title: Chicks
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with touches of gray wash over graphite on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of chicks in various poses. The color palette consists of black ink on a tan or brown paper background. There are sketches of chicks in different positions across the image.

artworks.title: Coastal Landscape
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with (faded) blue wash on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a grassy bank overlooking a serene landscape. The composition includes distant hills, scattered trees, grasses, and bushes rendered with expressive ink strokes. Clusters of trees and bushes lead the eye towards the horizon. The brushstrokes vary in detail and gesture, creating movement and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a sepia-toned background.

artworks.title: Sheep in a Manger
artworks.medium: gray wash with touches of pink watercolor over black chalk, heightened with white on gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of sheep in a field. Two sheep are in the foreground, one standing and one lying down, with more sheep in the background. The color palette consists of muted tones of gray, brown, and white, highlighting the texture of the sheep's wool. The scene includes a feeding trough extending from the left to the central portion, with other sheep clustered around it. A lantern hangs on the wall in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Bathers by a Giant Oak
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping and erasing, black chalk, and oil paint, with touches of white chalk, on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a large tree at the center. The tree has a dense canopy of dark green leaves with hints of light. Other trees in the distance create depth. The scene has a soft, dreamy effect with smooth brushstrokes. The color palette is earthy with warm browns and greens, complemented by light green and off-white patches. Two figures wade in a stream by the tree.

artworks.title: Tull on the River Waal
artworks.medium: gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a river landscape with people in a boat close to the viewer, two larger boats further out, and additional sailboats in the distance. A windmill, village, and church steeple are visible among the trees. The horizon is low in the composition, with a vast sky above. The artwork is monochromatic, using shades of gray to depict depth and atmosphere. Brushstrokes are delicate, conveying the calm water and the cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Ameide on the River Lek
artworks.medium: gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a view slightly above the water, displaying the river, sailboats in the distance, a boat with rowers, a small house by the riverbank, and a village with a steeple. The style is monochromatic with various shades of gray and smooth brushstrokes. The sky has billowing clouds and birds flying above.

artworks.title: Dante Meditating on the "Divine Comedy"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor over graphite, heightened with white gouache, on 3 joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring ghostly figures and mythical creatures surrounding a central man. The man is dressed in a red robe with a red cap on his head, and he is seated on a stone slab, a lamp sitting on a surface next to him. He has peach skin, and his face is partially in shadow. Surrounding him are countless intertwined humans, animals, and creatures in shades of white and gray. Many of the people are so tightly intertwined that their limbs and bodies are only partially visible. Above the man, a creature with the head and torso of a human but the legs of a horse and the wings of a bat rears up. In the upper left-hand corner, several people in long dresses reach up towards a white star-like shape that casts light on them. Two men and a woman on the left stand next to the central man, looking down at him. At the bottom of the painting is a snake, its mouth open to expose its fangs.

artworks.title: Classical Landscape with a Tempietto
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This drawing shows a landscape with tangled vegetation. Above the horizon, rolling clouds blend with distant hills. Beyond the bushes, ferns, vines, and branches closest to us is a flat body of water. On the opposite shore, to the left of center, is a structure resembling a domed pavilion with columns. On the shore near us, two people stand with their backs to us, looking across the water towards the pavilion. To the right, behind the trees, we can see a person walking behind a horse or donkey, and on the opposite shore four people walk near the pavilion, their silhouettes reflected in the water.

artworks.title: Rustic Building among Roman Ruins
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly tilted view focusing on a rustic building in the center. The horizon is higher in the frame, with rocks and trees blending with the structure. The technique uses soft lines and hatching for texture and depth. The color palette consists mainly of warm sepia tones creating a monochromatic, earthy feel. Shrubs and pathways lead the eye towards the building, with less detailed landscape in the background.

artworks.title: Details from "The Adoration of the Magi" and "The Pool at Bethesda"
artworks.artist: Jean Claude Richard de Saint-Non after Jean-Honoré Fragonard after Sebastiano Ricci
artworks.medium: etching (counterproof) reworked in brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.6 x 13.1 cm (7 5/16 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two figures engaged in a conversation. The person on the left wears a long robe and a turban, while the person on the right also wears robes, a turban, knee-high boots, and a sword. Below them are smaller sketches of various facial expressions, including a man with a turban and a full beard, and another figure with curly hair. The sketch is rendered in a monochrome style with a sepia tone, against a plain background.

artworks.title: Worship of the Golden Calf and Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: Jean Claude Richard de Saint-Non after Jean-Honoré Fragonard after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: etching [counterproof] reworked in brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.6 x 13.2 cm (7 5/16 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image is an artwork featuring two main sections. In the upper section, there are sketches of three men and a figure resembling a bull on a platform. One man stands on the right, partially nude with a cloth around his waist. The other two men are on the left, interacting with each other and the structure. In the lower section, there are three figures; two are reclined on a rocky surface, draped in fabrics, and another figure is seated looking to the right. The figures are presented in a fluid, classical art style with soft facial features and distinct hair. The background is plain, highlighting the figures and their clothing.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.5 x 27.7 cm (7 11/16 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural motif featuring Latin text surrounded by decorative elements. The central portion of the image is occupied by a block of text in Latin, which is surrounded by intricate architectural and ornamental designs. On each side of the text, there are figures resembling caryatids. Above the text, a semicircular arch is depicted with classical motifs, including armor and weaponry. The lower part of the image includes a decorative cartouche with flowers and a cherubic face. The entire drawing presents a composition reminiscent of classical antiquity with an emphasis on symmetry and ornamentation, rendered with fine detail and chiaroscuro techniques.

artworks.title: Tan y Bwlch, North Wales
artworks.medium: softground etching touched with graphite on light brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river curving into the scene. Cows are wading in the water near the viewer. A stone bridge spans the river in the middle of the composition. The scene transitions into lush banks with trees. In the distance, there is a mountain range under a sky with soft clouds. The artwork is done in a monochrome palette, using shades of black and gray for depth and texture. Brushstrokes create a play of light and shadow throughout.

artworks.title: Sheer Cliffs above a Coastal Road
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a cliff overlooking the sea. The horizon is a quarter down from the top, with the calm sea meeting the sky. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, showing the rocky cliff and lush vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic with light grays. A path winds through foliage on the cliff, and a small figure stands near the edge. Tall trees lean over the cliff.

artworks.title: Dedication Page
artworks.medium: Roman type on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Latin inscription. The image depicts a block of Latin text printed neatly on paper. It consists of text in two sections, an upper and lower part. The upper section is dedicated to a prominent hero, D. Antonio Peronoto, and acknowledges his virtues and contributions. It also references Hieronymus Cock as the creator. The lower section appears to be a poetic or literary reflection focusing on the ruins of Rome, mentioning various emotional and historical themes. The typography is classical and reflects a historical or solemn tone, suitable for an official dedication or commemoration.
